ValidationRule.description: Prevents any non-mgrs or coordinators from reopening a closed case (For Issues, task, cac, ncsp, and retention cases only)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND (ISCHANGED(Status),
OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Closed'),ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Complete'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Cancelled')),
OR($RecordType.Name = "CLAS – Data Management", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retention_RM", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retention_SH", $RecordType.Name = "NCSP: DMS", $RecordType.Name = "NCSP: DP New Customer Setup", $RecordType.Name = "NCSP: SKP Department Add Only", $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: Tech Services New Customer Setup', $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: Upsell', $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: New Customer Setup', $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: SKP New Customer Setup',$RecordType.Name = "Ad Hoc Report and Dashboard Request Cases" ),
OR($Profile.Name = 'AS Issue Res CSA1', $Profile.Name = 'AS CSA', $Profile.Name = 'AS NCSP CSA',$Profile.Name = 'AS Implementation Team'),
AND($Profile.Name <> "IM_Custom Sys Admin",$Profile.Name <> "IM_Sales Ops Super User",$Profile.Name <> "IME_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IME_Super_User",$Profile.Name <> "IM_Sales"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only managers, coordinators, and administrators can reopen a case or change the status of a closed case.
